diagnosis: The customer requested a billing contact change and refund from an unverified personal email address. Policy requires confirmation from a named account owner for such changes, necessitating human review for identity verification.
reply: Thank you for contacting support. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist. Requests that change billing details or address refunds require confirmation from a named account owner on record for security purposes. A specialist will review your request and guide you through the necessary identity confirmation steps.
